questions.question: Why can Toge Inumaki only say a few words?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: To avoid cursing others, he developed a unique speech pattern that limited his vocabulary to rice ball ingredients.

questions.question: How did Toge exorcise the curse at the Hapina Shopping Center?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta fought the spirit and managed to retrieve the throat medicine and throw it to Toge, who drank it and used his technique to crush the curse, exorcising it.

questions.question: How were Toge and Panda saved after Geto overpowered them?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuta then appeared and saved Toge, Panda, and Maki by healing them with reverse cursed technique.

questions.question: How did Toge and Panda help Megumi during his fight with Aoi Todo?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Toge and Panda then came to Megumi's rescue during his fight with Aoi Todo, with Toge immobilizing Todo with his Cursed Speech.

questions.question: What was Toge's role in the fight against Hanami?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Throughout the fight, Toge used his cursed technique to immobilize Hanami so that the other two could use hit-and-run tactics, though their attacks only scratched the curse.

questions.question: What did Toge lose during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Toge lost his left arm to Sukuna's attack.

questions.question: What command did Toge give to help free Gojo from the Prison Realm?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Toge gave the command to Hana Kurusu to use Jacob's Ladder on the back of the Prison Realm.

questions.question: What did Toge record for Yuta before the fight with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Toge Inumaki/Synopsis

answer.item: Toge recorded himself saying "don't move" with a recorder and gave it to Yuta.
